extracted.intended_audience: USPTO management, patent examiners, policymakers, and researchers analyzing patent workload and training program outcomes
extracted.subtask_description: Official USPTO performance/reporting metrics and program-design desiderata for examining, processing, and reporting patent (and related trademark) workload and training activities. Includes training program goals (TEALE) and the tables/definitions used to measure filings, disposals, pendency, issuances, reexaminations, contested cases, and related statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manager/mentor participation in TEALE
rubrics_metrics.description: Benefits and objectives of having managers/mentor attorneys act primarily as mentors within the TEALE training approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Immediate feedback/correction for presentations; ongoing, real-time evaluation of employees; unified message regarding how examination should be performed; stronger manager/employee engagement. (Presented as program design goals / evaluation criteria for TEALE implementation.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Elimination of tests/studying/fake files (TEALE design)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rationale and expected outcomes from removing artificial testing and ‘fake files’ from training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shorter classroom training—on production faster; teach to the job, not to the test. (Design criterion: training should be job-focused and reduce time-to-productivity.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Shortened presentations (TEALE design)
rubrics_metrics.description: Design principle for instructional units to improve engagement and learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Less stress on attention spans; wider variety of activities over course of a day. (Guides presentation length and activity variety in training design.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily real-file examination (TEALE practice)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of actual case files daily in training rather than solely classroom materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Increased sense of responsibility; less classroom burnout; better chance of immediately applying lessons learned; wider variety of topics covered. (Criterion for hands-on training fidelity and immediate applicability.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily case chats (TEALE practice)
rubrics_metrics.description: Short daily discussions about real cases to contextualize instruction and prepare staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deeper understanding of how presentations apply to real-life topics; mental 'warm up' for day’s activities; provides sense of how managers approach different situations; introduction to gray areas of decision-making; discussion with peers builds a sense of community. (Used as a metric/qualitative criterion for training effectiveness.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 1: Summary of Patent Examining Activities (FY 2012–FY 2016) (Preliminary for FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive summary metrics for patent examining activity across multiple fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes: Applications filed (total and by type: Utility, Reissue, Plant, Design), Provisional applications filed, First actions (by type and PCT/Chapter II), Patent application disposals (total), Allowed patent applications (total), Abandoned (total and by type), Statutory invention registration disposals, PCT/Chapter II examinations completed, Applications published, Patents issued (by type), Pendency time of average patent application (months), Reexamination certificates issued, PCT international applications received as receiving office, National requirements received as designated/elected office, and notes on renewals and footnotes (e.g., FY2016 preliminary; includes/excludes certain categories). Footnotes clarify scope (utility includes chemical/electrical/mechanical), provisional definitions, 18‑month publication, preliminary data caveats, and pendency definition excluding design patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 2: Patent Applications Filed (FY 1996–FY 2016) (Preliminary for FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual time series of patent applications filed by year and by application type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breaks out Utility, Design, Plant, Reissue, and Total counts per year. Footnote: FY2016 data are preliminary and will be finalized; includes same category definitions as Table 1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 3: Patent Applications Pending Prior to Allowance (FY 1996–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts of applications pending prior to allowance, including breakdown awaiting action by examiner and total applications pending prior to allowance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes utility, reissue, plant, and design applications; does not include allowed applications. Definitions note: 'Applications under examination' includes those in preexamination processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 4: Patent Pendency Statistics (FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pendency (measured in months) statistics for average first action and total average pendency, including breakdown by Technology Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UPR (Utility, Plant, Reissue) Pendency Statistics by Technology Center (1600, 1700, 2100, 2400, 2600, 2800, 3600, 3700) and aggregated Average First Action Pendency and Total Average Pendency. Metric units and tech-center mapping provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 5: Summary of Total Pending Patent Applications (FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stage-of-processing breakdown of total pending patent applications at fiscal year end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stages include: In preexamination processing; Under examination (undocketed; awaiting first action; subtotal awaiting first action; RCE awaiting first action; rejected awaiting response; amended awaiting action; in interference; on appeal and other); In postexamination processing (awaiting issue fee; awaiting printing; D-10s). Footnote: subtotal not included in total, includes cases on appeal and undergoing petitions, and definitions of withdrawn or zero values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 6: Patents Issued (FY 1996–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts of patents issued by patent type (Utility, Design, Plant, Reissue) and totals for each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes historical series, breakdowns of utility/design/plant/reissue, and footnote: counts may be revised from prior year reports; includes chemical, electrical, and mechanical within utility. Also includes aggregated totals and notes on exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 7: Patent Applications Filed by Residents of the United States (FY 2012–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic breakdown of patent applications filed by U.S. residents by state/territory across fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data include utility, plant, design, and reissue applications. Notes on finalized vs preliminary data, representation of U.S. Pacific Islands, and 'Other'/'N/A' entries where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 8: Patents Issued to Residents of the United States (FY 2015–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: State/territory breakdown of patents issued to U.S. residents for FY2015 and FY2016.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes utility, design, plant, and reissue patents. Footnotes: past years' data may have been revised; country/state coding notes; representation of territories and no-state records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 9: United States Patent Applications Filed by Residents of Foreign Countries (FY 2012–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Country-level counts of U.S. patent applications filed by foreign residents across fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Country listings include possessions and territories unless listed separately. Data include utility, design, plant, and reissue applications. Notes on preliminary FY2016 data and countries/territories newly reported; many country-level footnotes apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 10: Patents Issued by the United States to Residents of Foreign Countries (FY 2012–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Country-level counts of patents issued by the U.S. Patent Office to foreign residents by fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each patent grant listed under only one country of residence; includes utility, design, plant, and reissue patents. Footnotes about revisions to prior years for withdrawal status and country/territory reporting changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 11: Utility Patents Issued to Small Entities (FY 2012–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentages and origin breakdowns (micro entity, small entity, large entity) for utility patents issued, differentiating U.S. vs foreign origin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows percentage micro entity (introduced Mar 19, 2013), percentage small entity (with US and foreign origin split), and percentage large entity. Patent origin is based on first-named inventor residence; footnotes explain micro entity introduction and origin assignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 12: United States Government Agency Patents (FY 2012–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of utility patents assigned to U.S. government agencies at time of patent issue by fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies listed: Agriculture, Air Force, Army, Attorney General, Commerce, DHS, Energy, EPA, HEW/HHS, Interior, NASA, Navy, NSA, NSF, Postal Service, State Department, Transportation, TVA, USA (no agency indicated), VA. Notes: data subject to minor revisions; represents patents assigned to agencies as of issue date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 13A: Ex Parte Reexamination (FY 2012–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistics on ex parte reexamination requests and determinations by year and by filer/type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes: Requests filed (total, by patent owner, by third party, Commissioner ordered); Determinations on requests (total); Requests granted (by examiner, by petition); Requests denied; Requests known to have related litigation; Filings by discipline (Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, Design). Note: '– Represents zero.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 13B: Supplemental Examination (SE) (FY 2014–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and outcome determinations for Supplemental Examinations filed and granted a filing date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes SEs filed, SEs granted a filing date, Determinations on SE granted a filing date (SNQ found / not found), Requests known to have related litigation, and filings by discipline (Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, Design). Footnote: late-filed requests may not have been determined by year end; numbers may be revised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 14: Summary of Contested Patent Cases (Within the USPTO, as of September 30, 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and dispositions of internal contested patent proceedings (ex parte cases, appeals, interference, IPR, CBM transitional program, post grant review, derivation proceedings) as of the fiscal year end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports cases pending as of prior year, cases filed during FY2016, disposals, decided counts, cases pending at end of FY2016, rehearings, and special program counts. Includes note that Inter Partes Reexamination was replaced by Inter Partes Review (IPR) with AIA implementation and inter partes reexams are no longer counted; reinstituted case measure added for IPR/CBM/PGR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 15: Summary of Trademark Examining Activities (FY 2012–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Key trademark examination workload statistics across fiscal years, including applications filed, disposals, registrations, renewals, affidavits, and pendency measures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metrics include: Applications for registration (including additional classes); Disposal of trademark applications (registrations, abandonments, first actions, approvals for publication); Certificates of Registration issued by register type; Renewal of Registration (Section 9 filings); Section 8/15 affidavits filed/disposed; Amendments to Alleged Use, Statements of Use filed, Notices of Allowance; Total Active Certificates of Registration; Pendency averages (months) between filing and first action, between filing and registration/abandonment/NOA including and excluding suspended/inter partes proceedings. Footnotes explain workload counting conventions (extra classes) and renewal timings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 16: Trademark Applications Filed for Registration and Renewal and Trademark Affidavits Filed (FY 1996–FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of trademark filings for registration, renewal, and Section 8 affidavits by fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows counts for registration filings, renewal filings, and Section 8 affidavits across years; footnotes note changes in renewal terms and trademark law treaty impacts and that counts include extra classes where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 17: Summary of Pending Trademark Applications (FY 2016)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stage-of-processing breakdown for pending trademark applications at FY2016 year end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stages include pending applications total, in preexamination processing, under examination (applications under initial examination, amended awaiting action, awaiting first action), and other stage categories analogous to patent pending-stage breakdowns.
